item.title: V─O─Ti Bridge‐Bond Polarity Boosts Na + Migration in V‐Based Fluorophosphates for Fast Sodium Storage
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Ti4+ doping in V-based fluorophosphates creates polar V─O─Ti bridge bonds that reshape V electronic structure, enhancing V─O electron exchange and expanding Na+ transport channels. This suppresses high-voltage polarization and boosts Na+ migration, enabling 121.8 mAh g−1 at 0.1C and 62.1 mAh g−1 at 50C, with 154 Wh kg−1 at 9 Ah pouch-cell scale—advancing fast-charging, high-power sodium-ion batteries.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · fluorophosphate cathode · Ti doping · Na+ migration · bridge-bond polarity

💡 Metal–support magnetic interaction is used to overcome the spin barrier in Li–O₂ batteries. Interfacial magnetic coupling between Pd and ferrimagnetic CoFe₂O₄ restructures Pd spin states, promoting triplet O₂ conversion to peroxide while suppressing singlet O₂. item.title: Successive Redox Mediation Supported by Pnictogen Chalcohalide Enables High‐Performance Zinc–Sulfur Batteries
item.description:
نانومیله‌های Bi-S-Br به‌عنوان واسطه ردوکس چندمرحله‌ای، سینتیک ردوکس گوگرد را تسریع و باتری آبی Zn-S با ظرفیت و انرژی بالا را ممکن می‌کنند.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using Bi₁₂.₆₇S₁₈Br₂ nanorods with iodide additive to create successive redox mediation via gradient-potential couples (I⁰/I⁻ > Bi³⁺/Bi⁰ > S⁰/S²⁻), accelerating sulfur kinetics and suppressing side reactions. This enables high-capacity aqueous Zn–S batteries (792 mAh g⁻¹, 488.2 Wh kg⁻¹) with practical pouch-cell cycling, offering a new design principle for energy storage.
🏷 zinc-sulfur battery · redox mediator · pnictogen chalcohalide · Bi-S-Br · aqueous electrolyte

item.title: Regulated Co‐Solvation in Gel Polymer Electrolyte Enables Rapid and Selective Li + Ion Transport for High‐Rate Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:
الکترولیت ژل پلیمری با هم‌حلالی تنظیم‌شده، انتقال سریع و انتخابی Li+ را ممکن و باتری لیتیوم-فلز با نرخ بالا و عمر طولانی را فراهم می‌کند.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a matched polymer–electrolyte co-solvation state within a dual-regulated gel polymer electrolyte, combining a fluorinated backbone, amide crosslinker, and weakly solvating adiponitrile. This enables cooperative Li+ hopping and vehicular diffusion while suppressing anion migration, achieving 10,000 cycles at 6 C with 0.003% decay per cycle. It establishes co-solvation as a design framework for fast-charging lithium metal batteries.
🏷 gel polymer electrolyte · lithium metal battery · Li+ transport · co-solvation · high-rate
